description: Inspect the independent primary battery-and-open-switch DC circuit and coaxial secondary galvanometer circuit, with a removable iron core in the common bore. Apparatus identification only: no measured deflection, field arrows, current direction, permeability ratio or answer annotation.

authoritativeText.text:
磁导率 $\mu$ 表示物质对磁场的影响，本课沿用原书的记号，指相对于没有铁芯时的相对磁导率。
如果 $\mu$ 远远大于 1，例如铁的 $\mu$，就可以利用电磁感应来比较有铁芯和没有铁芯时的磁通量，从而测定它。

感生电动势与穿过线圈的磁通量变化率成正比，磁通量变化得越快，感生电动势的大小就越大。
在初级线圈的电流和装置几何条件相同的比较中，插入铁芯后，磁感应强度可按原书的记号表示为增大 $\mu$ 倍。
这里比较的是本装置在这些条件下的有效相对磁导率，而不是一个不随电流、铁芯形状和磁化状态改变的固定材料常数。

图 300 中，初级线圈接在直流电路中，次级小线圈绕在初级线圈上，并与检流计相连。
接通初级电路时，电流从初始值增加，穿过次级线圈的磁通量随之改变，次级回路中产生短暂的感生电流。
检流计的偏转显示这个感应过程；

电流和磁通量稳定后，不再因这一接通过程产生感生电动势。
分别比较没有铁芯和有铁芯时的接通过程，保持线圈的匝数、形状、初级电流的最终值以及次级回路电阻相同，并固定有铁芯时铁芯的放置位置。
两次测量还要从相同的初始磁通量开始，例如从无电流且没有剩余磁化的状态开始，不能把未控制的剩磁算作增强效果。

在次级回路电阻相同、感应脉冲完整结束的条件下，脉冲期间通过检流计的总电量与磁通量的总变化量成正比。
因此，在上述比较条件下，磁通量变化量及感生电动势的时间积分增大 $\mu$ 倍；
这不等于说任意时刻的感生电动势都按这个比值增大。

要用偏转比较总电量，需使用经过标定、适合测量短脉冲电量的检流计，并使脉冲持续时间远短于指针的机械响应时间。
这样，脉冲期间指针还来不及明显运动，随后第一次偏转的大小与通过的总电量成正比；
在这些测量条件下，插入铁芯后的偏转也增大 $\mu$ 倍。

原书报告，插入铁芯后测得的磁通量增大几千倍，说明铁在该测量条件下的有效相对磁导率很大。
铁芯内部电子的磁性在磁化后对总磁场的贡献，在这里与磁化线圈的磁场同向，因此使磁场增强。

The induced electromotive force is proportional to the rate of change of magnetic flux through a coil: a faster flux change produces a larger magnitude of induced electromotive force.

When the primary current and apparatus geometry are the same, the increase in magnetic flux density after inserting an iron core can be expressed, in the source notation, as a factor of $\mu$.

This comparison measures the effective relative permeability of this apparatus under those conditions, not a fixed material constant independent of current, core shape and magnetization state.

In Figure 300, the primary coil is connected to a direct-current circuit, and a smaller secondary coil wound around it is connected to a galvanometer.

When the primary circuit is switched on, the current rises from its initial value, changing the magnetic flux through the secondary coil and producing a brief induced current in the secondary circuit.

The galvanometer deflection indicates this induction process;
once the current and flux are steady, switching on no longer produces an induced electromotive force.

Compare switching on without the core and with it, keeping the coil turns and shape, the final primary current and the secondary circuit resistance the same, and fixing the core position when it is present.

Both measurements must also start from the same initial flux, for example with no current and no residual magnetization, so that uncontrolled remanence is not counted as an enhancement.

With the same secondary circuit resistance and after the complete induction pulse has ended, the total charge passing through the galvanometer is proportional to the total change in magnetic flux.

Under these comparison conditions, the flux change and the time integral of induced electromotive force increase by a factor of $\mu$;

this does not mean that the instantaneous induced electromotive force increases by that factor at every moment.

To compare total charge using deflection, use a calibrated galvanometer suitable for short charge pulses, with a pulse duration much shorter than the pointer's mechanical response time.

The pointer then barely moves during the pulse, and the magnitude of its subsequent first deflection is proportional to the total charge;

under these measurement conditions, inserting the core also increases the deflection by a factor of $\mu$.

The source reports that inserting the core increased the measured magnetic flux several thousandfold, showing that iron has a large effective relative permeability under those measurement conditions.

The contribution to the total field from the magnetism of electrons inside the magnetized core is, in this arrangement, in the same direction as the magnetizing coil's field, thereby strengthening it.

inventory.description: One left rectangular battery with a negative sign under its left top terminal and a positive sign under its right top terminal. The left battery terminal has a broad rising lead to the upper-left winding contact. The right battery terminal leads down/right to the left switch contact. One front knife switch has two contacts, a raised blade and a low rectangular base; its other contact returns to the lower winding through a lead at the support right. These form the primary DC circuit only. Source lengths and fine winding count are not calibrated facts. Modern battery plates replace the perspective box, without adding cells as a given; the source polarity and open blade are retained.

One upright cylindrical winding assembly occupies the center, with a dark oval upper flange/opening, a lower flange, dense transverse windings and a front vertical seam. It rests on a rectangular horizontally grained support with small face fittings and a right-side sloping lead. The prose distinguishes the long primary from the smaller secondary wound over it; pixels do not establish exact turn counts or a separately detached core. Preserve one shared vertical axis, a long primary and a shorter over-winding, plus the support. Modern regularization uses clean insulating end flanges, a small secondary band and three nonquantitative support hatch strokes, not a grained photograph.

Two distinct leads leave the right side of the winding assembly at different heights and run to two separate galvanometer terminals, one above/right of the other in the perspective source. Neither lead joins the battery, knife switch or primary contacts. The smaller secondary coil is around the primary, not alongside it and not electrically bonded to it. Modern secondary overlay masks underlying winding strokes at the shared insulating band, and routes its two external leads without cross-circuit crossings. Three illustrative secondary turns are schematic, not a source turn-number reading.

One large right rectangular analog galvanometer with a lower foot, two wired terminal fittings, an arched scale of short radial ticks, a central 0, apparent 5 endpoint numerals on both sides, and a vertical pointer aligned with the central mark. Below the scale is a small rectangular internal mechanism containing a pivot/coil detail; the lower face has two adjustment-like round fittings. Preserve the zero-centered pointer, ticked symmetric scale, terminal separation and simplified mechanism, without a deflection result or a scale unit. Source endpoint numeral reading is confirmed separately from an enlarged pixel crop; no calibrated current, flux, permeability, pulse trace or outcome is added.

Explicit modern additions from the frozen bilingual prose: an axially aligned removable iron-core rod partially shown above the upper opening; its continuation into the winding bore is muted and dashed to distinguish hidden core from an electric lead. A clean flanged tube opening substitutes for the perspective ellipse. The source pixels do not show a detached rod or motion arrow. English Primary coil, Secondary coil, Removable iron core, DC battery, Switch and Galvanometer identify existing/prose-described components. Thin muted leader segments are nonconductive label guides, not circuit connections. No current/flux direction, quantitative response or answer is disclosed.
